name: sql-plsql-formatter
description: Formats Oracle SQL and PL/SQL in VS Code the way Oracle SQL Developer does: UPPERCASE keywords, 4-space indent, one clause and one column per line. Fully configurable.

sqlPlsqlFormatter.keywordCase.description: Case for keywords and data types (SELECT, BEGIN, VARCHAR2...).

sqlPlsqlFormatter.identifierCase.description: Case for table, column, variable and function names. Quoted "Names" are never changed.

sqlPlsqlFormatter.useTabs.description: Indent with tabs instead of spaces.

sqlPlsqlFormatter.useEditorIndentation.description: Use the editor's tab size / spaces setting instead of indentSize and useTabs.

sqlPlsqlFormatter.commaPosition.description: Put commas at the end of the line (trailing) or at the start of the next line (leading).

sqlPlsqlFormatter.breakAndOr.description: Start AND / OR conditions in WHERE and HAVING on a new line.

sqlPlsqlFormatter.maxBlankLines.description: Maximum number of blank lines kept between statements.
